messages:
Jamie: CI red on nightly run (build 4821). Several failures in runtime::serve::serve_retry_test, looks nondeterministic. Logs below.
```
FAILED serve_retry_test::test_interleaved_retries
runtime/serve/retry.rs:142
assert_eq!(order, [0,1]) but got [1,0]
```
Jamie: Anyone nearby to triage?

CI-bot: ci: rerun queued for build 4821, job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/4821/try  (rerun-id=4821.2)

Alexa: saw this too. Repro locally is flaky. Suggest running a seed-scan (1..1000) to find a deterministic repro seed. Also suspect real-time timers; can we run with FAKE_CLOCK env?

Chris: I'll start the seed-scan - assigning to myself. Which hash range should we bisect between?

Jamie: suspect regression between d1f4a2b (green) and 0a7c9e5 (first red).

Mohammed: also check for any uses of thread::sleep or Instant::now in that test. If the test relies on wall-clock timing it's fragile. Grep for Sleep/Instant and chrono usage.

Alexa: kicking off seed-scan now. Command I ran:
```bash
./tools/seed_scan --test runtime::serve::serve_retry_test --start-seed 1 --end-seed 1000 --ci-job 4821
```
Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/seed-scan/4821.2/status  :eyes:  

CI-bot: seed-scan started (id=772). Estimated runtime ~30m.

Chris: FYI I'm going to try running the test under a fake clock wrapper to see if timing is the root cause. If fake clock stabilizes it, we'll know it's a timer/timing race.

Jamie: if seed-scan finds a repro seed please paste seed + failing output here and I'll take ownership of the bisect.

Mohammed: ping me when you have the seed, I can add instrumentation around the timer calls.

Alexa: seed-scan found seed=317. Repro locally with:
```bash
RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 RUST_TEST_SEED=317 cargo test -p runtime serve_retry_test::test_interleaved_retries
```
Output:
```
thread 'serve_retry_test' panicked at 'assertion failed: order == [0,1]', runtime/serve/retry.rs:142
```

Chris: starting bisect between d1f4a2b..0a7c9e5 with seed 317 now. Command: 
```bash
./ci/bisect --range d1f4a2b..0a7c9e5 --test runtime::serve::serve_retry_test --seed 317
```

CI-bot: bisect job queued (id=883). Will post results here when done.

Jamie: amazing, thanks. If bisect points at a timing-related commit let's land a fake-clock wrapper in the test and file a regression issue.

Alexa: created issue INF-742 to track flaky test + follow-up. I'll attach bisect output when it lands. :white_check_mark: 

CI-bot: bisect completed: culprit commit 7c9d12e (timer jitter refactor). Marked probable regression.

Mohammed: confirmed locally. That refactor computes sleep durations with float math and can produce off-by-one ms ordering differences. Switching to integer ms arithmetic fixes the ordering. I'll open a PR with the fix.

Chris: I'll add a test variation that runs under FAKE_CLOCK to make the timing deterministic in CI.

Jamie: perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Keeping this thread for status updates on the PR and the follow-up test hardening.
